## Why

`slicer relay-run step --role` accepts only implementer, reviewer, gate, architect or orchestrator (`ROLE_NAMES`, src/slicer/roles.py:31; checked at src/slicer/ops.py:3107). ork's relays run a read-only UI pass on UI slices, in parallel with the reviewer (its matrix row r14, rule u10), and plan a batched read-only spec check before a wave (ork adj 164). Both are recorded today as `reviewer` with a task suffix, so `relay-run list` and the TUI cannot tell them apart. Seen on every UI slice of ork's 2026-10-23..25 run (S33, S84, S65 and more).
